content.value: The summer after my third year, I interned at Beehive Design, a Toronto design studio specializing in brand identity, digital design, and print communications.

, I researched thematic directions for a Cecconi Simone rebrand. The award-winning interior firm had recently begun working with Beehive. The internship focused on visual research, interview analysis, brand positioning, and mapping conceptual territories for a refreshed identity.
